historical_basis: Kakongo/Malemba coastal nucleus north of Cabinda; Vansina634-636. Native-cell envelope cannot certify coastal cadastral limits.
Ngoyo/Cabinda north-bank coastal nucleus before1783; Vansina635-636.
North-bank estuary hinterland adjoining Ngoyo, not direct royal Kongo domain; river-locality comparison.
Mpinda/Soyo south-bank mouth and neighbouring coastal district, distinct from MbanzaKongo crown; boundary approximate.
Mpinda/Soyo south-bank mouth and neighbouring coastal district, distinct from MbanzaKongo crown; boundary approximate.
Northern coastal chiefdom aggregate after Mayumba secession fromLoango c1750; no precise cultural boundary asserted.
Ndembu local authorities south of royal Kongo core; not all Kongo-speaking lands under the crown.
Ndembu eastern interface beside Matamba and Encoje, native-cell approximation.
Encoje1759 small presidio represented by existing native cell; scope is fortified node and attached corridor, not uniform provincial control.

Connected Kwanza presidio corridor Muxima/Massangano/Cambambe/Ambaca/PungoAndongo, established before1776. Native-cell corridor is an explicit coarse political approximation, not title to all intervening villages.
Matamba royal nucleus north/east of Kwanza posts, separate from Kasanje upperKwango market.
Matamba northern interface adjoining native upperKwango nucleus, not Yaka nineteenth-century southward extension.
Kasanje/Casanje upperKwango nucleus east of Kwanza posts, not all broad Chokwe interior.
Local Kisama/Libolo and southern-Kwanza chiefdoms outside royal Kasanje and Portuguese posts; no all-interior colonial sovereignty.
Northern Bailundo plateau interface adjoining Mbailundu nucleus; no full late19c sphere.
Bailundo royal plateau core north of Huambo, one of two major kingdoms developing by1772; not whole Ovimbundu ethnic envelope.
Bihé/Cuito highland royal nucleus east of Bailundo, distinct from later broad Chokwe expansion.
Portuguese coastal title narrowed away from inland districts north of Benguela; NovoRedondo coastal node retained.
Benguela-Caconda1769 attached road/presidio corridor on native cells, contiguous as explicitly required by player; broader than actual garrison reach, not all plateau.
